description_en: Retrieves the details of a host, such as the name, source, address, protocol, and service port
description_zh: 包括主机名称、来源、主机地址、协议端口等信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHost

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host in which you want to query the host.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host in which you want to query the host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机所在堡垒机的区域ID。
> Region ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host that you want to query. You can specify only one host ID.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query the ID of the host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机ID。仅支持输入一个主机ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id
